"""Real model test proposal corrected during recorded human review."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import app as app_module


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    app_module.init_db()
    with TestClient(app_module.app) as c:
        yield c


def test_create_short_link(client):
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path10"})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    code = response.json()["short_code"]
    assert code and code != "https://example.com/path10"
    stats = client.get(f"/links/{code}")
    assert stats.status_code == 200
    assert stats.json() == {"original_url": "https://example.com/path10", "click_count": 0}


def test_redirect_with_click_increment(client):
    created = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path11"})
    assert created.status_code == 201
    code = created.json()["short_code"]
    for count in [1, 2]:
        response = client.get(f"/r/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 307
        assert response.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/path11"
        assert client.get(f"/links/{code}").json()["click_count"] == count


def test_missing_code_returns_404(client):
    for path in ["/r/missing", "/links/missing"]:
        response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert response.json() == {"detail": "Code not found"}


def test_invalid_url_rejected(client):
    for url in ["javascript:alert(1)", "ftp://example.com", "http://127.0.0.1/",
                "https://10.0.0.1/", "http://[::1]/", "http://localhost/",
                "https://user:password@example.com/", "http://example.com:99999/"]:
        assert client.post("/links", json={"url": url}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/links", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_collision_exhaustion(client, monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    def same_code(size):
        calls.append(size)
        return "collision"
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module.secrets, "token_urlsafe", same_code)
    first = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/first"})
    assert first.status_code == 201
    calls.clear()
    second = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/second"})
    assert second.status_code == 503
    assert second.json() == {"detail": "Five code-collision attempts exhausted"}
    assert len(calls) == 5
    assert client.get("/links/collision").json() == {"original_url":"https://example.com/first", "click_count":0}

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import app as app_module


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))

    with TestClient(app_module.app) as c:

def test_create_short_link(client):
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path10"})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    code = response.json()["short_code"]
    assert code and code != "https://example.com/path10"
    stats = client.get(f"/links/{code}")
    assert stats.status_code == 200
    assert stats.json() == {"original_url": "https://example.com/path10", "click_count": 0}


def test_redirect_with_click_increment(client):
    created = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path11"})
    assert created.status_code == 201
    code = created.json()["short_code"]
    for count in [1, 2]:
        response = client.get(f"/r/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 307
        assert response.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/path11"
        assert client.get(f"/links/{code}").json()["click_count"] == count


def test_missing_code_returns_404(client):
    for path in ["/r/missing", "/links/missing"]:
        response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert response.json() == {"detail": "Code not found"}


def test_invalid_url_rejected(client):
    for url in ["javascript:alert(1)", "ftp://example.com", "http://127.0.0.1/",
                "https://10.0.0.1/", "http://[::1]/", "http://localhost/",
                "https://user:password@example.com/", "http://example.com:99999/"]:
        assert client.post("/links", json={"url": url}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/links", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_collision_exhaustion(client, monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    def same_code(size):
        calls.append(size)
        return "collision"
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module.secrets, "token_urlsafe", same_code)
    first = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/first"})
    assert first.status_code == 201
    calls.clear()
    second = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/second"})
    assert second.status_code == 503
    assert second.json() == {"detail": "Five code-collision attempts exhausted"}
    assert len(calls) == 5
    assert client.get("/links/collision").json() == {"original_url":"https://example.com/first", "click_count":0}

"""Real model test proposal corrected during recorded human review."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import app as app_module


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    app_module.init_db()
    with TestClient(app_module.app) as c:
        yield c


def test_create_short_link(client):
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path10"})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    code = response.json()["short_code"]
    assert code and code != "https://example.com/path10"
    stats = client.get(f"/links/{code}")
    assert stats.status_code == 200
    assert stats.json() == {"original_url": "https://example.com/path10", "click_count": 0}


def test_redirect_with_click_increment(client):
    created = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path11"})
    assert created.status_code == 201
    code = created.json()["short_code"]
    for count in [1, 2]:
        response = client.get(f"/r/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 307
        assert response.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/path11"
        assert client.get(f"/links/{code}").json()["click_count"] == count


def test_missing_code_returns_404(client):
    for path in ["/r/missing", "/links/missing"]:
        response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert response.json() == {"detail": "Code not found"}


def test_invalid_url_rejected(client):
    for url in ["javascript:alert(1)", "ftp://example.com", "http://127.0.0.1/",
                "https://10.0.0.1/", "http://[::1]/", "http://localhost/",
                "https://user:password@example.com/", "http://example.com:99999/"]:
        assert client.post("/links", json={"url": url}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/links", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_collision_exhaustion(client, monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    def same_code(size):
        calls.append(size)
        return "collision"
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module.secrets, "token_urlsafe", same_code)
    first = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/first"})
    assert first.status_code == 201
    calls.clear()
    second = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/second"})
    assert second.status_code == 503
    assert second.json() == {"detail": "Five code-collision attempts exhausted"}
    assert len(calls) == 5
    assert client.get("/links/collision").json() == {"original_url":"https://example.com/first", "click_count":0}

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import app, init_db, db_path
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import secrets

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_short_link(tmp_path):
    monkeypatch = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    init_db()
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path10"})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    assert response.json() == {"short_code": "https://example.com/path10"}
    with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM Link WHERE short_code = ?", (response.json()["short_code"],))
        result = cursor.fetchone()
        assert result[1] == "https://example.com/path10"
        assert result[2] == 0


def test_redirect_with_click_increment(tmp_path):
    monkeypatch = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    init_db()
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path11"})
    code = response.json()["short_code"]
    response = client.get(f"/r/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
    assert response.status_code == 307
    assert response.headers["Location"] == "https://example.com/path11"
    with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT click_count FROM Link WHERE short_code = ?", (code,))
        result = cursor.fetchone()
        assert result[0] == 1


def test_missing_code_returns_404(tmp_path):
    monkeypatch = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    init_db()
    response = client.get("/r/invalid_code")
    assert response.status_code == 404
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Code not found"}


def test_invalid_url_rejected(tmp_path):
    monkeypatch = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    init, db()
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "javascript:alert(1)"})
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Use a public HTTP(S) destination without credentials"}


def test_collision_exhaustion(tmp_path):
    monkeypatch = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    init_db()
    secrets.token_urlsafe = lambda x: "collision"
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path12"})
    assert response.status_code == 503
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Five code-collision attempts exhausted"}
    with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM Link WHERE short_code = ?", ("collision",))
        result = cursor.fetchone()
        assert result is None

"""Real model test proposal corrected during recorded human review."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import app as app_module


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module, "db_path", str(tmp_path / "links.db"))
    app_module.init_db()
    with TestClient(app_module.app) as c:
        yield c


def test_create_short_link(client):
    response = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path10"})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    code = response.json()["short_code"]
    assert code and code != "https://example.com/path10"
    stats = client.get(f"/links/{code}")
    assert stats.status_code == 200
    assert stats.json() == {"original_url": "https://example.com/path10", "click_count": 0}


def test_redirect_with_click_increment(client):
    created = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/path11"})
    assert created.status_code == 201
    code = created.json()["short_code"]
    for count in [1, 2]:
        response = client.get(f"/r/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 307
        assert response.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/path11"
        assert client.get(f"/links/{code}").json()["click_count"] == count


def test_missing_code_returns_404(client):
    for path in ["/r/missing", "/links/missing"]:
        response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert response.json() == {"detail": "Code not found"}


def test_invalid_url_rejected(client):
    for url in ["javascript:alert(1)", "ftp://example.com", "http://127.0.0.1/",
                "https://10.0.0.1/", "http://[::1]/", "http://localhost/",
                "https://user:password@example.com/", "http://example.com:99999/"]:
        assert client.post("/links", json={"url": url}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/links", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_collision_exhaustion(client, monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    def same_code(size):
        calls.append(size)
        return "collision"
    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module.secrets, "token_urlsafe", same_code)
    first = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/first"})
    assert first.status_code == 201
    calls.clear()
    second = client.post("/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/second"})
    assert second.status_code == 503
    assert second.json() == {"detail": "Five code-collision attempts exhausted"}
    assert len(calls) == 5
    assert client.get("/links/collision").json() == {"original_url":"https://example.com/first", "click_count":0}
